subject: How to make a boxplot with every variable have a position in the X

messages.author: 6d2292d0608e533f
messages.subject: How to make a boxplot with every variable have a position in the X
parts:
Here is the str() of my data,
 "'data.frame:2485 obs. of  37 variables:".
 I need to make a boxplot, and place every variable in the X, and their observation in the Y. I can do it with
SHS<-SH[,14:37]
boxplot(SHS)

But the plot is not quite pretty as you can see.
So how can I do it in ggplot2?

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: How to make a boxplot with every variable have a position in the X
parts:
Something along these lines. 

require(reshape2)
require(ggplot2)

df<-data.frame(Butterfinger = rnorm(50, 25, 10), Snickers=rnorm(50, 75, 20), Skor=rnorm(50, 115, 35), AlmondJoy=rnorm(50, 45, 5))

df.melt<-melt(df)
ggplot(df.melt, aes(x=variable, y=value))+geom_boxplot()
